acquisition_constraints.allowed_current_inputs: pinned headers, 120 public-scalar bytes, config, index, tokenizer and workload

deterministic_unblock_procedure: Verify the pinned metadata, workload and ordered public-scalar digests already present in the repository.

Obtain an owner-approved Gemma-only arithmetic specification containing every weight and activation exponent, the exact rounding and saturation rules, and a proved accumulator bound for every operation kind.
Obtain the LUT generator and schema; regenerate every table deterministically and record both the schema digest and the concatenated table digest.
After a separate authorization, use only an owner-provided local checkpoint whose two pinned LFS SHA-256 values verify; do not download weight bodies or use a pod under this tranche.

Stream the 772 BF16 private tensors in canonical terminal order into little-endian i16 with zero point 0, reject overflow according to the frozen rule, require exactly 61394690560 bytes, and hash the packed stream.

Run the frozen workload through independent Gemma-only Python and Rust implementations, compare every emitted witness value and output token bit for bit, and hash and register the canonical comparison report plus golden manifest.
Create a new instantiated profile artifact for review; never change this requirements artifact to PASS.
